title: When does the routine run?
hook: A toy cue starts two actions per round. Compare keeping and removing that cue.

knows: basic arithmetic and how to compare two stated rules
doesNotKnow: how to separate a specified trigger policy from evidence about an acquired habit

misconception: Repeating a rule-driven cue simulation demonstrates that human habits persist after removing cues.
objective: Separate a specified trigger policy from evidence about an acquired habit.

claims.text: Original stipulated toy: No starting actions; each present cue supplies exactly two counted actions; no decay, acquisition, rewards or competing causes. Keeping the cue records {A}; removing it records {B}. The programmed trigger supplies actions; no habit strength is inferred.
